resources.string: No room on the home screen
Lets Spark gestures lock the screen and open recents

Spark uses this only to lock the screen, show recent apps, and open the notification shade when you use a gesture you set up. It does not read the screen, see what you type, or collect any data. Spark has no internet access.
Turn on Spark Launcher in Accessibility to use this gesture
